title: CHAPTER 8: TELANGANA-SPECIFIC TOPICS FOR COMPETITIVE EXAMS

blocks.content: Telangana State Police is one of the well-organized police forces in India. The Director General of Police (DGP) heads the entire force.

items: Telangana State Police – Civil Police
Telangana Special Police (TSP) – Armed Reserve
District Armed Reserve (DAR)
Greyhounds – Counter-insurgency force
OCTOPUS (Organisation for Counter Terrorist Operations) – Hyderabad; anti-terrorism
HAWK (Hyderabad Area Wide Knowledgeable) – Intelligence unit
CID – Crime Investigation Department
SOT – Special Operations Team (anti-Naxal)
SIT – Special Investigation Team
Rachakonda, Cyberabad, Hyderabad Commissionerates – Three urban police commissionerates

blocks.content: 8.2 TSPSC – Telangana State Public Service Commission
The Telangana State Public Service Commission (TSPSC) conducts recruitment examinations for various posts in Telangana government. It was established after bifurcation in 2014.

items: Chairman: Appointed by Governor on advice of Chief Minister
Key exams: Group-I, Group-II, Group-III, Group-IV, SI, Constable, AEE, JL, AE, etc.
Headquarters: Nampally, Hyderabad

cells: Telangana Industrial Project Approval and Self-Certification System (TS-iPASS)

items: Telangana formed: June 2, 2014 (29th State of India)
First CM: K. Chandrashekar Rao | First Governor: ESL Narasimhan
State capital: Hyderabad | State animal: Spotted Deer | State bird: Indian Roller
Kakatiya capital: Warangal (Orugallu) | Greatest Kakatiya ruler: Ganapati Deva
Ramappa Temple: UNESCO World Heritage Site (2021) | Built by: Recharla Rudra (1213 CE)
Golconda Fort and Hyderabad: Founded by Qutb Shahi sultans
Charminar built: 1591 CE by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah
Operation Polo: September 17, 1948 | Telangana Liberation Day: Sept 17
Sammakka-Saralamma Jatara: World's largest tribal fair; Medaram village; every 2 years
Kaleshwaram Project: World's largest multi-stage lift irrigation project on Godavari
Srisailam Dam: On Krishna river; 2nd largest reservoir in India by capacity
Nagarjuna Sagar: One of world's largest masonry dams; on Krishna river
Hyderabad: IT capital; HITEC City; Genome Valley; Pharma Capital of India
TRS formed: April 27, 2001 by K. Chandrashekar Rao (KCR)
Telangana districts: 33 (post 2016 reorganization)
Assembly seats: 119 | Rajya Sabha seats: 7 | Lok Sabha seats: 17
Pochampad Dam (Sriram Sagar): On Godavari; oldest major irrigation project in Telangana
Nizamabad: Largest turmeric market in Asia
Perini Shivatandavam: Ancient dance revived by Dr. Nataraja Ramakrishna
Pochampally Ikat: GI-tagged handloom product of Telangana
PV Narasimha Rao: 14th PM of India; born in Karimnagar; launched 1991 liberalization
Komaram Bheem: Gond tribal leader; 'Jal Jangal Zameen'; died fighting Nizam 1940
State language: Telugu (also Urdu as additional official language in some districts)
Telangana River: Godavari is longest river; Krishna is second most important
Bathukamma: Floral festival; celebrated during Dasara; symbol of Telangana identity
